title: Ordered graph-Koszul diagonal normalization and its comparison data
statement:
Let R and B be commutative rings with R-algebra structure on B. A localized polynomial chart of B is an integer n, a commutative R-algebra P, a map c:R[x_0,...,x_{n-1}]→P making P a localization at one polynomial h, and a surjective R-algebra map p:P→B [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Let V=∧^n_P Ω_{P/R}, v=dc(x_0)∧...∧dc(x_{n-1}), L=V in degree -n (canonically V[0][n]), C=RHom_P(B,L), A=B⊗_R B, C_1=C⊗^L_{B,p_1}A, δ:A→B multiplication [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-trf-derived-coinduction]. The scalar-extension and diagonal multiplication/class maps are the existing ordinary-module maps of [lem-trf-affine-relative-dualizing-comparison], with derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Set T=P⊗_R B_2, q=p⊗1:T→A, e=δq. The graph Koszul complex K on c(x_i)⊗1-1⊗p(c(x_i)) is [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], extended from nonnegative chain to nonpositive cochain degrees. Its coefficient line V_T=T⊗_P V carries volume 1⊗v. A graph trace τ:C_e(V_T[n])≅B[0] is normalized when its inverse adjunct, pulled back by the augmented graph Koszul resolution K→e_*B[0] (whose degree-zero unit maps to 1), is the top cocycle K→V_T[n] sending the ordered top graph wedge to 1⊗v. A diagonal isomorphism κ:C_δ(C_1)≅B[0] is normalized when it is the composite of coinduction applied to the scalar-extension exchange β:C_1≅C_q(V_T[n]), the unique coinduction-transitivity comparison with composite evaluation counit, and that graph trace. The exchange β is characterized by extension of the evaluation counit, composed with the scalar mate of V→q_*V_T. Its scalar/restriction mate and coefficient comparison are required invertible. Define ξ as the coinduction adjunct of κ^{-1}.
A chart change consists of compatible maps R→S, B→D and P→P', preserving the number and order of coordinates, with the semilinear map on top differentials carrying v to v'. It is admissible when the quotient square is a pushout and either the base square is a pushout or the base map is an isomorphism and P and B simultaneously localize h and p(h). Its coefficient comparison is the scalar mate of the differential map; its model comparison is normalized by the extended evaluation counit. The induced diagonal-ring map acts on both factors; the comparison of diagonal degree-zero objects is the scalar mate of b:B→D. Preservation of ξ is the commuting square with those canonical diagonal and first-pullback maps.
A one-variable refinement is P[t]→B with old-coordinate inclusion, evaluation t↦a in P, and the new coordinate last; its polynomial-ring identification preserves old coefficients and t. Its coefficient contraction is normalized by the short exact sequence V_Q --(t-a)→ V_Q → V_P, where the last map sends the ordered new volume to the old volume: it is the Koszul evaluation of this two-term resolution, the cocycle sending the degree -1 term identically to V_Q (dual(t-a)⊗d(t-a)↦1), which is the convention of the graph trace above; with the mapping-cone triangle convention this is minus the connecting morphism of the sequence. The model map pastes the two evaluation counits with this contraction. Preservation means this model map carries ξ_Q to ξ_P and agrees with the maps from all other lifts for the same two charts. An ordered refinement path is the identity or a finite composite of these normalized model maps. All comparisons use the ordinary cohomological shift and tensor signs.

reviewed_lean.note: F1 (H3, sign): IsKoszulDiagonalRefinement.IsContraction pins the contraction by Mathlib's ShortExact.singleδ. Its mapping-cone triangle has mor₃ = −fst (inl_v_triangle_mor₃_f), so it is the negative roof, while IsKoszulDiagonalGraphTrace uses the positive Koszul cocycle (top wedge ↦ volume; project koszulComplex d(e)=+f matches the cone differential +φ). The refinement clause is then false: with n=0, R=B=P=ℤ, Q=ℤ[t], t↦0, the model map sends ξ_Q to −ξ_P; a chain-level lift through K(x,t) gives the same −1 for every n. FIX: fixes/PolynomialKoszulDiagonalData.lean uses (-hs.singleδ)⟦n⟧' with a convention docstring; fixes/def-sfb-polynomial-koszul-diagonal-data.json rewrites only the statement sentence on the contraction (Koszul evaluation dual(t-a)⊗d(t-a)↦1, minus the cone connecting morphism). No recorded lean.statement changes. Other checks pass: β, τ and κ are uniquely pinned by their counit and cocycle equations, so the ∃-assignment is not hollow; ξ is the adjunct of κ⁻¹; no extra hypotheses (Noetherian R, flat finitely presented B, no flatness of R→R'); scalar, localization, identity and composition changes, lift independence and ordered iterates are rendered; edge cases n=0, B=0, h=1, h=0, R=0 covered; statement verbatim; source and blueprint docstrings present; only the item theorem is sorry; no duplicate notion found. Advisory: multiplication by ξ uses the helper's closed internal Hom rather than the recorded derived internal Hom; IsIso does not depend on that choice. The fixed Data module plus the delivered System and Class modules compile clean in one nt_compile --json call (7.5/3.0/4.8 s, exit 0, no warnings beyond sorry).
